messages:
marta: Quick brain-dump: I sketched a "replay" affordance for the version history timeline. idea: a small ▶️ play button that steps through diffs (highlights changed files, routes, and traffic allocation) instead of a full modal. prototype: https://redwood.internal/prototypes/replay-timeline.png

lena: Love the concept. Two UX concerns: 1) how do we signal that replay is read-only vs a live rollback action? 2) keyboard accessibility for stepping and scrubbing.

sam: Agree re: action affordance. Copy suggestion: label the control "Replay changes" and put a smaller tertiary "Rewind to this version" CTA next to each step in the scrubber when hovered/focused. That separates a passive replay from a commit action.

aria: Accessibility notes: the play control needs aria-pressed or role="button" with clear state announcement. Each step should expose accessible labels like "Step 3: traffic 10% to v2, 90% to v1, changed routing rule checkout-service". Use role="list"/role="listitem" for the strip to help screen readers navigate. Also respect prefers-reduced-motion: if reduced, show instant state jumps rather than animated transitions.

kevin: Implementation thoughts: we'll build the scrubber as a canvas-based strip for perf, but canvas isn't great for SR. Solution: render an offscreen accessible list mirror with same semantics (visually hidden) and keep visual for sighted users. Telemetry: fire events on play start/stop, step forward/back, and when user clicks a rollback CTA.

marta: Good call on the SR mirror. For the visual scrubber I want compact ticks plus a micro-preview hover (small tooltip with diff summary). On hover show a snapshot card; on focus show the same card.

lena: Mobile behaviour? The scrubber will be tight on mobile. Maybe replace with a stacked vertical list + a single sticky play control that toggles autoplay between steps. Also make the preview full-width in mobile to aid touch targets.

sam: Copy detail: what about the replay CTA inside the timeline card? e.g., "Replay changes" vs "Preview changes". I think "Preview changes" is clearer that it's non-destructive.

aria: +1 to "Preview changes" for clarity with screen readers. When the preview is active announce: "Previewing change 1 of 6: checkout-service, route updated". And when autoplay ends announce "Preview complete". Avoid announcing too many intermediate states for verbosity.

kevin: Edge case: if a user starts previewing while on a canary that's still allocating, the live system could change. We'll capture a snapshot of the timeline state at preview start and clearly show a small badge: "Preview snapshot (stale)" if underlying live state changes. Also disable rollback buttons while preview snapshot is stale.

marta: Visual treatment: small blue play pill at left of timeline header, ticks centered, a translucent scrubber thumb. When thumb focused show keyboard hint: "←/→ to step, space to play/pause, r to rewind". Thoughts?

lena: Love keyboard hint. Make sure hints are discoverable only on focus, not persistent. Also ensure color contrast on the blue pill meets AA.

sam: Minor copy: use sentence-case for the hint text? "Press ← or → to step; space to play/pause" reads less cluttered.

aria: One more a11y nit: when the preview card appears, don't auto-focus into it. Keep focus on the scrubber control but make the preview reachable via Enter. That prevents focus traps for keyboard users.

marta: Plan: I'll update comps with the following changes: - change CTA label to "Preview changes" - add hover/focus preview card - mobile stacked mode + sticky play - SR mirror markup example - reduced-motion variant

kevin: I'll spike the canvas scrubber + offscreen list in staging and wire telemetry. Will also add a feature flag for the autoplay speed (default 700ms per step).

design-bot: Accessibility checklist updated: timeline preview + scrubber added by @aria. https://redwood.internal/checklists/a11y-timeline

lena: Next steps: marta uploads new comps, kevin prototypes in staging, aria + QA run VoiceOver/NVDA passes, sam will finalize microcopy for labels and hints. ETA for first pass: EOD Thu.

marta: Thanks all. I'll post updated PNGs here once ready :coffee:
